title: Dune Allen "Side Beach" 21 Breeze Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf Views- Private Pool **Pool heating is available for $35 per day**- Low-Speed Vehicle- 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Welcome to Side Beach, a stunning home in the picturesque Dune Allen community along the Emerald Coast. With breathtaking Gulf views, 5 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and 2,652 square feet of living space, this retreat ensures comfort and luxury for up to 21 guests. It's the perfect setting for a memorable Gulf getaway—a short 2-minute drive from the beach—with a private pool, ping-pong table, and giant tic-tac-toe board.Experience the ultimate outdoor retreat at this stunning 3-story stilted home along the Emerald Coast. The ground floor features a covered patio with plush seating and 2 TVs, a kidney-shaped pool with sun loungers, outdoor shower, and fun games like ping-pong, darts, and tic-tac-toe. An outdoor grill makes alfresco dining fun and easy.Details exude sophistication throughout the first floor of this coastal retreat. The sleek white kitchen features high-end appliances, marble countertops, and a spacious island with seating for 5. Adjoining the kitchen is a quaint wet bar with a wine cooler and coffee maker. The well-lit dining area offers a stylish mix of bench and chair seating, comfortably accommodating 10-13 guests at a time. The cozy living area with calming touches of blue complements the Gulf views. Warm hardwood floors and a 65" TV create the perfect setting for movie nights at home. Families will appreciate the versatile bunk room on this floor, featuring a twin-over-king bed. The cool coastal breeze and outdoor furnishings beckon guests to the sun-filled deck through French doors—total paradise!The second floor has 3 comfy bedrooms—2 guest bedrooms with a king and queen bed and 1 primary bedroom with a king bed, private bath with a soaking tub, cozy TV area, and breathtaking balcony views.Head to the third floor, where a bunk room with 3 full-over-full beds and a private bathroom are complemented by a convenient wet bar with a mini fridge. A top-floor balcony offers unobstructed panoramic views of the Gulf!Embrace the coastal lifestyle with unparalleled leisure at Side Beach! With on-site parking for 3 vehicles—plus 5 adult bikes and a 6-passenger golf cart—it’s easy to explore the area. For Dune Allen Beach Access, take Breeze Drive north to Sunset Avenue and then turn right. Turn right again onto 30A, and the beach will be visible from Hilltop Drive. Book this fantastic Florida property today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 21):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-King Bunk Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Three Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Dune Allen "Side Beach" 21 Breeze Drive Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 5 Beds 11 Sleeps 21 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf Views - Private Pool **Pool heating is available for $35 per day** - Low-Speed Vehicle - 5 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Welcome to Side Beach, a stunning home in the picturesque Dune Allen community along the Emerald Coast. With breathtaking Gulf views, 5 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and 2,652 square feet of living space, this retreat ensures comfort and luxury for up to 21 guests. It's the perfect setting for a memorable Gulf getaway—a short 2-minute drive from the beach—with a private pool, ping-pong table, and giant tic-tac-toe board. Experience the ultimate outdoor retreat at this stunning 3-story stilted home along the Emerald Coast. The ground floor features a covered patio with plush seating and 2 TVs, a kidney-shaped pool with sun loungers, outdoor shower, and fun games like ping-pong, darts, and tic-tac-toe. An outdoor grill makes alfresco dining fun and easy. Details exude sophistication throughout the first floor of this coastal retreat. The sleek white kitchen features high-end appliances, marble countertops, and a spacious island with seating for 5. Adjoining the kitchen is a quaint wet bar with a wine cooler and coffee maker. The well-lit dining area offers a stylish mix of bench and chair seating, comfortably accommodating 10-13 guests at a time. The cozy living area with calming touches of blue complements the Gulf views. Warm hardwood floors and a 65" TV create the perfect setting for movie nights at home. Families will appreciate the versatile bunk room on this floor, featuring a twin-over-king bed. The cool coastal breeze and outdoor furnishings beckon guests to the sun-filled deck through French doors—total paradise! The second floor has 3 comfy bedrooms—2 guest bedrooms with a king and queen bed and 1 primary bedroom with a king bed, private bath with a soaking tub, cozy TV area, and breathtaking balcony views. Head to the third floor, where a bunk room with 3 full-over-full beds and a private bathroom are complemented by a convenient wet bar with a mini fridge. A top-floor balcony offers unobstructed panoramic views of the Gulf! Embrace the coastal lifestyle with unparalleled leisure at Side Beach! With on-site parking for 3 vehicles—plus 5 adult bikes and a 6-passenger golf cart—it’s easy to explore the area. For Dune Allen Beach Access, take Breeze Drive north to Sunset Avenue and then turn right. Turn right again onto 30A, and the beach will be visible from Hilltop Drive. Book this fantastic Florida property today!
